title: Rabbi Dosa ben Tevet
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: A precious aggadah of his remains to us in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8, where Rabbi Chanina speaks in his name: “The Holy One, blessed be He, created two inclinations: the inclination to idolatry and the inclination to sexual immorality. The inclination to idolatry has already been uprooted; the inclination to immorality still exists. The Holy One, blessed be He, said: Whoever can withstand immorality, I credit him as though he withstood both.”

notes.text: The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8 has Rabbi Chunya in the name of Rabbi Dosa bar Tevet, while Hyman’s supplied notice names Rabbi Chanina. The saying about the two inclinations is present in that passage.
